purpose: Build a provenance-rich raw-mixed Math candidate pool for curation evaluation, not a benchmark-targeted training set.
forbidden_uses: using GSM8K or MATH benchmark content as training candidates
using benchmark, NLL, or downstream outcomes as Stage-B selector inputs
treating reference-pool membership as a selector feature or label
claim_boundary: Collection evidence only. Candidate-pool provenance and lexical exclusions do not certify benchmark-clean or production-ready data.
